words.def: a piece of writing about one subject in a newspaper or a magazine

steps.prompt: In all four sentences, what does used to tell you about now?
options: that it is still true today
that it will be true in the future
that it was true before, but has changed
steps.answer: that it was true before, but has changed

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ say what was true before and is not true now — I used to walk to school
✓ make it negative and ask about it — I didn’t use to… / Did you use to…? — without the d
✓ choose between used to and the past simple by what you mean
✓ say There used to be… about a place that has changed
✓ talk about the news — flood, forest fire, hurricane, crash, strike, election, robbery
✓ use four phrasal verbs — find out, grow up, set up, carry on
